messages:
maya: Quick note — discovered inconsistency across SDK examples for streaming + pagination. Python shows resume_token and streaming, TS and Go still show single-shot calls. We should align before tomorrow's docs release.

tom: yikes. which files?

maya: docs/guide/streaming.md and docs/reference/pagination.md — python snippet got updated in recent PR but others didn't.

li: paste the python snippet?

maya: short version:
```python
resp = client.responses.create(model=\"rwd-4x\", input=prompt, stream=True, resume_token=last_token)
for evt in resp:
    if evt.type == 'delta':
        sys.stdout.write(evt.delta)
```

akiko: nice. TS should demonstrate async iterator + resumeToken, not just await single response.

kevin: I can take TS. propose async iterator pattern: 
```ts
const stream = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-4x', input: prompt, resumeToken: lastToken });
for await (const ev of stream) {
  if (ev.type === 'delta') process.stdout.write(ev.delta ?? '');
}
```

li: I'll update Go. current Go examples call Create() once or use List() without retry handling. I'll add a cursor loop + simple exponential backoff and show handling of Retry-After.

maya: can we add a tiny smoke test harness under examples/smoke/ that runs mocked snippets for all three languages? docs-ci can run it in the docs workflow.

docs-ci: yes, add smoke harness under /examples/smoke/ and label PRs with `ci: docs-smoke` to trigger job. We can mock network calls so CI doesn't hit prod.

kevin: timeline — I'll open TS PR with smoke test in ~2h.

li: Go PR in ~3h. will include explicit Retry-After handling example.

maya: I'll open a small cross-ref PR that links streaming.md <-> pagination.md and add a one-line note about resume_token mapping across languages (idiomatic names: `resume_token` in Python, `resumeToken` in TS, `ResumeToken` in Go). Keep it short.

akiko: agree on idiomatic names. also add a short paragraph about idempotency vs resume semantics so users know when to re-send prompt vs resume.

kevin: opened PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4470 (TS + smoke harness). CI linted, fixed indenting, smoke job mocked pass.

li: opened PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4471 (Go cursor + retry example). please review @akiko.

maya: opened cross-ref PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4472. left a tiny wording nit.

tom: will review after lunch. can we aim to merge all before docs cut tomorrow morning?

maya: yes — i'm coordinating approvals. once merged i'll update release notes: \"Unify streaming + pagination examples across SDKs; add resume/retry guidance and smoke tests.\"

docs-ci: automated check: PR 4470 merged, PR 4471 pending review, PR 4472 merged. docs:smoke passed for merged PR.

kevin: PR 4471 got a small ping from @akiko — addressing suggested clarifying comment about TTL for resume tokens. will update shortly.

li: pushed fix and requested re-review.

maya: thanks everyone. closing thread — reopen if anything blocks the release. :shipit:
